versions.changelog:
Initial release — guided Game Design Document writing using structured templates.

- Step-by-step workflow walks users through each GDD section with targeted questions and markdown templates.
- Detailed prompts and templates for mechanics, systems, narrative, levels/world, UI/UX, audio, content, monetization, and tech specs.
- Platform notes provided for OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor/Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and general LLM chats to optimize document creation on any tool.
- Flexible output supports both master documents and per-section files for easy team collaboration.
- Designed for comprehensive, navigable game design docs suitable for real-world development teams.
